source.title: Rift Away
source.description: Join me in this historic experiment and witness the wonders of my invention! I've calculated two locations with suitable geothermic bioflux energy. With manual-auto-locking phasers, I'm ready to send us to the coordinates within compatible regions.
source.objective: Assist Doctor Jurgens with rift opening at either Tirisfal Glades or Westfall
source.completion: Jurgens has gone missing in the chaos. You see a shimmering wafer within a cylindrical crystal container. Inside are the smashed-up remains of interior workings of the golem. You reach inside, unfasten wires from the housing, and open it.
